feed.title: Truehound sub-processor changes
feed.subtitle: Material changes to the third parties Truehound engages to deliver a hosted deployment.

entry.title: Register matches the providers the hosted product actually uses
entry.summary: The register now lists exactly the providers hosted Truehound uses: Stripe (billing), Cloudflare (the connector Worker and Workers KV) and GitHub Pages (hosting), plus PostHog and Anthropic only if those features are enabled. Earlier entries described a hosted architecture and placeholder vendors that Truehound does not use, and are withdrawn.
